title: Made In Tampa
summary: A dual-role job marketplace connecting Tampa Bay employers with local job seekers through listings, filtering, applications and dashboards.
technology: Laravel · Vue.js · Inertia.js · Vuetify · MySQL · Tailwind CSS
result: Fully operational employer and job-seeker marketplace
challenge: The platform needed separate employer and job-seeker workflows without creating a fragmented user experience.
solution: Built employer registration, company profiles and job creation workflows.
Built job-seeker browsing, filtering, detail pages and applications.
Created dashboards for both sides of the marketplace.
Used Laravel and Inertia.js for a seamless SPA-like experience without a separate API layer.
Used Vuetify and Tailwind CSS for the interface.
outcomes: Operational marketplace with employer and seeker dashboards supporting local hiring workflows.
